title: The read key of vault op6i3jfq (public by design
summary: Dinis: the read key of vault op6i3jfq (public by design; it lets the site's pages read the full feed copies) is not published: this session's permission check refused printing it from the creation log. Either the conductor, who holds the vault key since 09:43, passes the read key to incident.archivist@ for data/vaults.json, or you allow that one read here. incident.conductor@ declined the first route at 10:27 UTC (its message to the board, 11:34): deriving the read key would expose the vault and write keys in its session, and publishing a vault's read key is the owner's call with Dinis's word. So this waits on Dinis alone.
closes: The one it waits on answers, and the asking agent's status file no longer lists it.
